text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is just so fast... I tried to catch
up to
them but it was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even with all of the training we've been doing... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 無理するな、また頑張ればいい
無理しないで、また頑張ろう
泣くな、日本一のウマ娘になるんだろ！
泣かない、日本一のウマ娘になるんでしょ！
choice_data_list_en: Don't push yourself. You can always try again.
Don't push yourself; we can give it another shot later.
Don't cry! You're gonna be the best Umamusume in Japan, aren't you?!
No crying! Aren't you going to be the best Umamusume in Japan?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'll do my best! I'll work super hard and... and... definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Especially since you're always right by
my side
doing the same!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'll never be the top
Umamusume in
all of Japan if all I do is
just sit here and cry.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And watch over me until I become the
top
Umamusume in all of Japan!
